I couldn't confirm Jérôme d'Ambrosio's team history with the search tool. Its results only return race reports and season standings, and none of my queries surfaced his career or teammate data. So this answer rests on my own recollection, not on retrieved sources.

From memory, d'Ambrosio's race seats were with Virgin Racing/Marussia, and his teammates there were Timo Glock, Max Chilton and Jules Bianchi. None of them won a drivers' championship in 2000–2025. The 2013 and 2014 standings I retrieved confirm that Chilton and Bianchi never won a title. The Glock and d'Ambrosio pairing is a recollection I couldn't verify. I'm also not certain whether he had any other race-seat teammates, such as at Lotus or Caterham, so a championship-winning teammate can't be ruled out. If he did, that would be a gap in this answer.

ANSWER: none
